quality_assessment: Page provides accurate basic information about lookaround assertions but lacks visual enhancements, practical workflow guidance, and integration with MkDocs Material features. Content is technically correct but could benefit from structured examples and decision-making guidance.

issues.description: Page lacks MkDocs Material visual features like admonitions, tabs, and code annotations that are used extensively in other advanced pattern pages (e.g., index.md, examples.md, pcre2.md)
issues.fix_suggestion: Add visual features: (1) Use admonitions for warnings (e.g., '!!! warning' for PCRE2 requirement), (2) Add code annotations with (1)!, (2)! syntax to explain command components, (3) Consider tabs for organizing different lookaround types

issues.description: Use cases section (lines 52-59) lists benefits but lacks concrete examples and decision guidance on when to choose lookaround over alternatives
issues.fix_suggestion: Expand use cases with: (1) Decision flow diagram showing when to use lookaround vs alternatives, (2) Before/after comparisons with non-lookaround approaches, (3) Performance implications, (4) Common pitfalls to avoid

issues.description: Section lists four types of lookaround (lines 7-12) but provides minimal explanation of how they differ and when to use each type
issues.fix_suggestion: Add practical guidance: (1) Show visual diagram of match behavior for each type, (2) Explain zero-width nature of assertions, (3) Compare positive vs negative and ahead vs behind with examples, (4) Common use case for each type

issues.description: Page mentions PCRE2 requirement in subtitle (line 5) but doesn't emphasize it as a warning or explain error when -P flag is missing
issues.fix_suggestion: Add prominent warning admonition after introduction: '!!! warning "PCRE2 Required" Lookaround assertions require the `-P` flag. Without it, patterns will fail with regex parse errors. See [PCRE2 Engine](./pcre2.md) for details.'

issues.description: Example on line 31 shows multiline lookbehind but doesn't explain why -U is needed or link to multiline documentation
issues.fix_suggestion: Add explanation or annotation: 'Lookbehind across lines requires `-U` (multiline mode). See [Multiline Search](./multiline.md) for details.'

issues.description: No mention of performance implications of lookaround assertions compared to simpler patterns
issues.fix_suggestion: Add tip admonition: '!!! tip "Performance Note" Lookaround assertions can be slower than simple patterns, especially with backtracking. Use the simplest pattern that meets your needs. See [Performance Considerations](./performance.md) for details.'

issues.description: Code examples lack annotations to explain pattern components, unlike examples.md and index.md which use (1)!, (2)! syntax extensively
issues.fix_suggestion: Add code annotations to explain complex parts: (1) Mark lookaround assertions with annotations, (2) Explain quantifiers and character classes, (3) Clarify why specific flags are needed
